SELECT si.code, si.order_type AS orderType, si.approve_status AS approveStatus, si.customer_id AS customerId, si.invalid_status AS invalidStatus, si.sales_org_name AS salesOrgName, si.seller_name AS sellerName, sod.delivery_status AS deliveryStatus, si.require_date AS requireDate, si.create_user_name AS createUserName, si.create_time AS createTime, si.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, si.virtual_warehouse_id as virtualWarehouseId, si.receive_amount AS receiveAmount, si.id,sod.id AS detailId, si.approve_user_name AS approveUserName, si.approve_time AS approveTime, si.sales_dept_id AS salesDeptId, si.all_amount_lc AS allAmountLc, si.remark, si.customer_order_no AS customerOrderNo, si.is_declare as isDeclare, si.is_upload_label as isUploadLabel, sod.sku_id AS skuId, sod.sku_no AS skuNo, sod.qty, sod.amount, sod.currency, sod.delivery_qty AS deliveryQty, sod.currency_symbol AS currencySymbol, sod.price, sod.tax_amount AS taxAmount, sod.tax_rate AS taxRate, sod.tax, sod.remark as detailRemark, sod.cost_source as costSource, ci.country_id as countryId, sod.exchange_rate AS exchangeRate, sod.amount_local_currency AS amountLocalCurrency, sod.all_amount_local_currency AS allAmountLocalCurrency, sod.frozen_qty as frozenQty, sod.is_close, sod.to_country as toCountry, fdp.id as partitionId, fdp.code as partitionCode, fdp.name as partitionName, COALESCE(sdnd.deliveryQty, 0) as effectiveNoticeQty, (sod.qty - COALESCE(sdnd.deliveryQty, 0)) as remainingNoticeQty FROM so_info si LEFT JOIN so_detail sod ON sod.main_id =si.id AND si.is_deleted=false left join customer_info ci on si.customer_id = ci.id and ci.is_deleted = false left join foreign_dict_partition fdp on fdp.id = si.partition_id and fdp.is_deleted = false left join ( select sum(sdnd.delivery_qty) as deliveryQty ,sdnd.source_detail_id from so_delivery_notice sdn left join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false where sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.approve_status = 'approve' group by sdnd.source_detail_id ) sdnd on sod.id = sdnd.source_detail_id
left join ( select sum(vi.qty) as virtualQty ,vi.sku_id,vi.virtual_warehouse_id,vi.warehouse_id from virtual_inventory vi where vi.is_deleted = false and vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' group by vi.sku_id,vi.virtual_warehouse_id ,vi.warehouse_id ) vi on vi.sku_id = sod.sku_id and si.virtual_warehouse_id = vi.virtual_warehouse_id and si.warehouse_id = vi.warehouse_id
WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and sod.is_deleted=false
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
si.create_time DESC,sod.id ASC

SELECT COALESCE(sum(sod.qty),0) as totalQty, COALESCE(sum(sod.delivery_qty),0) as totalDeliveryQty, COALESCE(sum(sod.amount),0) as totalAmount, COALESCE(sum(sod.tax_amount),0) as totalTaxAmount, COALESCE(sum(sod.amount_local_currency),0) as amountLocalCurrency, COALESCE(sum(sod.all_amount_local_currency),0) as allAmountLocalCurrency, COALESCE(sum(sod.frozen_qty),0) as totalFrozenQty FROM so_info si LEFT JOIN so_detail sod ON sod.main_id =si.id AND si.is_deleted=false left join customer_info ci on si.customer_id = ci.id and ci.is_deleted = false
left join ( select sum(sdnd.delivery_qty) as deliveryQty ,sdnd.source_detail_id from so_delivery_notice sdn left join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false where sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.approve_status = 'approve' group by sdnd.source_detail_id ) sdnd on sod.id = sdnd.source_detail_id left join ( select sum(vi.qty) as virtualQty ,vi.sku_id,vi.virtual_warehouse_id,vi.warehouse_id from virtual_inventory vi where vi.is_deleted = false and vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' group by vi.sku_id,vi.virtual_warehouse_id ,vi.warehouse_id ) vi on vi.sku_id = sod.sku_id and si.virtual_warehouse_id = vi.virtual_warehouse_id and si.warehouse_id = vi.warehouse_id
WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and sod.is_deleted=false
${params.permissionSql}

SELECT sod.id FROM so_info si LEFT JOIN so_detail sod ON sod.main_id =si.id AND si.is_deleted=false left join customer_info ci on si.customer_id = ci.id and ci.is_deleted = false
left join ( select sum(sdnd.delivery_qty) as deliveryQty ,sdnd.source_detail_id from so_delivery_notice sdn left join so_delivery_notice_detail sdnd on sdn.id = sdnd.main_id and sdnd.is_deleted = false where sdn.is_deleted = false and sdn.approve_status = 'approve' group by sdnd.source_detail_id ) sdnd on sod.id = sdnd.source_detail_id left join ( select sum(vi.qty) as virtualQty ,vi.sku_id,vi.virtual_warehouse_id,vi.warehouse_id from virtual_inventory vi where vi.is_deleted = false and vi.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' group by vi.sku_id,vi.virtual_warehouse_id ,vi.warehouse_id ) vi on vi.sku_id = sod.sku_id and si.virtual_warehouse_id = vi.virtual_warehouse_id and si.warehouse_id = vi.warehouse_id
WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and sod.is_deleted=false
${params.permissionSql}
